---
title: "Publishing Checklist"
---

```{=html}
<style>
  .checklist-wrap { padding: 1.5rem 0; max-width: 680px; }
  .section-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-secondary); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 1rem; }
  .main-item { border: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary); border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg); margin-bottom: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-background-primary); }
  .main-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; }
  .main-item.all-done .main-row { background: var(--color-background-success); }
  .cb { width: 18px; height: 18px; min-width: 18px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border-secondary); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .cb svg { display: none; }
  .cb.done { background: var(--color-background-success); border-color: var(--color-border-success); }
  .cb.done svg { display: block; }
  .main-text { flex: 1; }
  .main-label { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-primary); margin: 0 0 2px; }
  .main-item.all-done .main-label { color: var(--color-text-success); }
  .main-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }
  .main-item.all-done .main-desc { color: var(--color-text-success); opacity: 0.75; }
  .sub-list { border-top: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary); padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.75rem 2.75rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
  .sub-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 5px 6px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; }
  .sub-item:hover { background: var(--color-background-secondary, #f5f5f5); }
  .sub-cb { width: 15px; height: 15px; min-width: 15px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border-secondary, #ccc); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: 1px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .sub-cb svg { display: none; }
  .sub-cb.done { background: var(--color-background-success, #e6f4ea); border-color: var(--color-border-success, #4caf50); }
  .sub-cb.done svg { display: block; }
  .sub-label { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-primary); line-height: 1.5; }
  .sub-item.checked .sub-label { color: var(--color-text-secondary); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--color-border-secondary, #ccc); }
  .sub-label code { font-family: monospace; font-size: 11.5px; background: var(--color-background-tertiary, #f0f0f0); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; }
  .progress-bar-wrap { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin-bottom: 5px; }
  .progress-track { height: 4px; background: var(--color-background-tertiary, #eee); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; }
  .progress-fill { height: 100%; background: #4caf50; border-radius: 2px; transition: width 0.3s ease; }
  .done-msg { display: none; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text-success, #2e7d32); margin-top: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--color-background-success, #e6f4ea); border-radius: 8px; }
  .reset-btn { margin-top: 1rem; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); background: none; border: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary, #ddd); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; }
  .reset-btn:hover { background: var(--color-background-secondary, #f5f5f5); }
</style>

<div class="checklist-wrap">
  <p class="section-title">From plotting to publishable</p>
  <div class="progress-bar-wrap">
    <div class="progress-label"><span>Progress</span><span id="p2p-prog-label">0 / 22</span></div>
    <div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" id="p2p-prog-fill" style="width:0%"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div id="p2p-checklist"></div>
  <div class="done-msg" id="p2p-done-msg">Everything ticked — ready to publish!</div>
  <button class="reset-btn" onclick="p2pReset()">Reset</button>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const ITEMS = [
    {
      label: "Structure",
      desc: "Does the repo follow a logical layout?",
      subs: [
        "Data, scripts, results, and docs are in clearly named separate folders",
        "No unrelated files mixed together (e.g. data files alongside scripts)",
        "A clear entry point exists — it's obvious where to start",
        "Nested folders have a documented purpose or workflow"
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "README & documentation",
      desc: "Could a stranger run this independently?",
      subs: [
        "README explains what the project does and why",
        "Dependencies and how to install them are listed",
        "Step-by-step instructions for running the code are included",
        "Inputs and expected outputs are described",
        "The role of each script or folder is explained"
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "Clean code",
      desc: "Free from common code smells?",
      subs: [
        "No hardcoded absolute file paths (e.g. <code>/Users/dezrae/Desktop/data.csv</code>)",
        "No dead code — commented-out blocks or functions that are never called",
        "No unused imports or packages",
        "No leftover debug print statements or TODOs",
        "Consistent, descriptive variable and function names",
        "Consistent indentation and formatting throughout",
        "Functions have docstrings or inline comments explaining their purpose"
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "Environment file",
      desc: "Is the software context fully captured?",
      subs: [
        "An <code>environment.yml</code> (Conda) or <code>renv.lock</code> (R) is present in the root",
        "The file reflects the current state of the environment",
        "Language version (Python/R) is specified",
        "All required packages and their versions are pinned"
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "No raw data, results, or credentials",
      desc: "Are the right files excluded from version control?",
      subs: [
        "A <code>.gitignore</code> is present and covers data files, results, and system files",
        "No raw data files are committed to the repository",
        "No credentials, API keys, or tokens are anywhere in the repo history",
        "Results that can be regenerated from code are not committed",
        "Raw data is archived in a dedicated data repository with its own DOI"
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "Licence",
      desc: "Is the code legally usable by others?",
      subs: [
        "A <code>LICENSE</code> file is present in the root of the repository",
        "The licence is appropriate for the intended use (e.g. MIT for permissive, GPL for copyleft)",
        "Data and documentation have their own licence if needed (e.g. CC BY 4.0)"
      ]
    },
    {
      label: "Citable snapshots",
      desc: "Can this code be cited in a paper?",
      subs: [
        "A GitHub release has been created with semantic versioning (e.g. <code>v1.0.0</code>)",
        "The repository is linked to Zenodo (or equivalent) for DOI minting",
        "A DOI badge is added to the README",
        "A <code>CITATION.cff</code> file is present so GitHub renders a 'Cite this repository' button"
      ]
    }
  ];

  const TOTAL = ITEMS.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.subs.length, 0);
  let state = ITEMS.map(i => i.subs.map(() => false));

  function svg(size) {
    return `<svg width="${size}" height="${Math.round(size*0.82)}" viewBox="0 0 11 9" fill="none"><polyline points="1,4.5 4,7.5 10,1" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>`;
  }

  function render() {
    const container = document.getElementById('p2p-checklist');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    ITEMS.forEach((item, i) => {
      const allDone = state[i].every(Boolean);
      const doneSubs = state[i].filter(Boolean).length;
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'main-item' + (allDone ? ' all-done' : '');
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="main-row">
          <div class="cb${allDone ? ' done' : ''}">${svg(11)}</div>
          <div class="main-text">
            <p class="main-label">${item.label} <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:var(--color-text-tertiary,#999);margin-left:4px;">${doneSubs}/${item.subs.length}</span></p>
            <p class="main-desc">${item.desc}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sub-list">
          ${item.subs.map((s, j) => `
            <div class="sub-item${state[i][j] ? ' checked' : ''}" data-i="${i}" data-j="${j}">
              <div class="sub-cb${state[i][j] ? ' done' : ''}">${svg(9)}</div>
              <span class="sub-label">${s}</span>
            </div>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
      container.appendChild(div);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('#p2p-checklist .sub-item').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', function() {
        state[parseInt(this.dataset.i)][parseInt(this.dataset.j)] ^= true;
        updateProgress();
        render();
      });
    });
  }

  function updateProgress() {
    const done = state.flat().filter(Boolean).length;
    document.getElementById('p2p-prog-label').textContent = done + ' / ' + TOTAL;
    document.getElementById('p2p-prog-fill').style.width = Math.round((done / TOTAL) * 100) + '%';
    document.getElementById('p2p-done-msg').style.display = done === TOTAL ? 'block' : 'none';
  }

  window.p2pReset = function() {
    state = ITEMS.map(i => i.subs.map(() => false));
    updateProgress();
    render();
  };

  render();
  updateProgress();
})();
</script>
```
